changeSet.sql: -- Match case-insensitive authentication without changing tenant membership. -- Existing UNIQUE (business_id, email) is case-sensitive and allows case variants. -- Fail on existing duplicates so they can be resolved explicitly; never merge or -- delete staff automatically. NULL remains allowed for staff without email login. CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_staff_business_email_ci ON identity.staff (business_id, lower(email));
